items.metric: LIVE GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, third week of decline, largest fall in the set)
items.effect: Stream volume held (89 streams in lives.json) while LIVE GMV collapsed, so yield per stream fell to about 3.0 from an 11.7 fourteen day average.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams, alldaysteals carries the bidet stream, and hold stream count near 90 to 100 until yield per stream recovers above 10.

items.metric: Collab invites sent (third week of decline, upstream of all sampling)
items.effect: Invites halved while 9,585 DMs still went out, so inbound interest cannot refill the sample stage for early October.
items.action: Restart invites toward the prior 12,221 from the existing outreach lists and confirm the Sep 18 and Sep 19 zero-invite days are not recurring.

items.metric: Sample requests (third week of decline, feeds October content)
items.effect: Requests fell to 68 while only 16 shipped and 12 were delivered, so October creator supply is already smaller than September's.
items.action: Clear the 47 To Review requests today, highest post rate first, and re-screen the 77 expired items for creators who still post.

items.metric: GMV (fourth consecutive decline, inside runs of three weeks or more in Orders, Units, Affiliate GMV, LIVE GMV, DMs, Collab invites and Sample requests)
items.effect: The week closed at 602.63 GMV per day against 1,030.93 and Affiliate GMV at 79.5% of the total fell in step, so this is a level shift rather than a partial week.
items.action: Track the Sep 21 to 27 week against the 602.63 daily run and treat sample approvals and shipping as the only levers that reach October GMV.

items.metric: GMV Max Back to School campaign ROAS against its 5.4 target (campaign flag, below 1.0)
items.effect: The campaign spent 289.66 to return 83.97 on 3 orders, a 205.69 gap before commission and COGS, while Shop Wide also sits below its target at 1.15 against 2.0.
items.action: Cap or pause the Back to School campaign and move its 289.66 of weekly spend to Screen Door at 2.00, the only enabled campaign clear of breakeven.

items.metric: Sample pipeline rejected or expired (share of the 300 request window)
items.effect: 223 of 300 requests closed without a sample while 47 sit To Review with 2026-10-03 expiry dates, so inbound demand is still discarded faster than it is worked.
items.action: Screen on post rate and GPM before rejecting and work the 47 To Review queue today, starting with bell2310805 at 96.73% post rate.
